Name: Epic Maulch

Description.name: Epic Maulch
Description.description: After a great feast, what becomes of all the leftover food? Does it go to waste? Not on the Wubbox's watch! In a 'ground-breaking' feat, naturally-decomposing material has been merged with Maulch's already soiled state to produce a three-headed Epic whose commitment to environmentalism should be lauded, if not its outward presentation.

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Maulch
